raw_comment:
We notice that droughts are in central United States. We also notice that the coastlines have the least amount of droughts. 

We wonder what is causing these and if the dryness has been increasing or decreasing?

This relates to us in Colorado because it is dry and we have a lot of mountains so we get a lot of droughts. 

"Parched Nation: America's Drought Struggle Intensifies"
